identifier: compounds according to the invention of the general formula (I)
notes: Tabelle 2 is an enumeration table. Its caption fixes R2 = Cl, R3 = SO2Me, R4 = H, R5 = H, R6 = OR12, R7 = R7a, R7b, Y = CH2, Z = CH2, v = 1, w = 2, and its rows (Nr. 30-389) assign R7a, R7b, R12, L and R1. Every row is a substituent assignment rather than a complete compound name, so under rule 8 no row yields a record. The only whole-molecule term the section names is the caption's pointer to the invention class, recorded here unresolved because formula (I) is defined elsewhere in the document. Two internal inconsistencies in the table are reproduced and not corrected: Nr. 270 prints H, H, Bz, CH2CH2, O-c-Hexyl, which repeats Nr. 150 exactly and breaks the L = CHMe run that Nr. 271 onward follows; and Nr. 180 to 182 write R12 as 4-Me-PhC(O) where the rest of the table writes the same group as 4-Me-Bz. There are no IMAGE_EXTRACT spans in this section.
